title: Raku Kiln Sales with Optional Training
source_quote: Nate Winter Studios Raku kilns are designed as durable, portable firing systems for Western Raku and related firing techniques. Each kiln package includes the essential components needed to establish a propane-fired Raku kiln setup.
evidence_sentence: The Raku Kilns page offers complete Raku kiln packages for $1,250 with optional online training through The Fire Circle membership to learn kiln operation.
evidence_quote: Nate Winter Studios Raku kilns are designed as durable, portable firing systems for Western Raku and related firing techniques.
summary: Nate Winter Studios sells complete propane-fired raku kiln packages ($1,250) shipped throughout the continental United States, with optional online training via The Fire Circle membership ($29/month) to learn operation, safety, and firing techniques.
cost_text: $1,250 for kiln package; $200–$400 shipping; optional $29/month training
how_to_join: Submit purchasing inquiry form; payment methods include Venmo, PayPal, check, or credit card
